digest.component_or_area: terraform drift gate and Gerrit CI integration
propositions: Terraform drift workflow does not trigger on Gerrit changes, only on pull_request, push to main, and schedule; therefore unapplied terraform reaches main after submit without being checked
A change touching infra/terraform/** can pass all CI gates and be submitted despite containing unapplied resources because the drift check runs post-merge rather than pre-submit
The 34cd change added aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm.review_interrupts to HCL but it was never applied to CloudWatch, yet passed Verified gate and landed to main
Manual terraform apply is decoupled from the landing workflow and not enforced, allowing applied and unapplied changes to be indistinguishable at submit time
The pre-submit drift check must distinguish between a change's own new resources (expected non-empty plan) and previously-committed unapplied resources (actual defect)
